subject: Saving likelihood values at each iteration

messages.author: 061281a8cdc1f42e
messages.subject: Saving likelihood values at each iteration
parts: Does anyone have any recommendations for the best way to save the likelihood value and iteration number from mirt()? I'd like to be able to plot the values by iterations. I'm sure I could figure this out but just wanted to check first to see if there was a quick solution.

messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: Saving likelihood values at each iteration
parts:
See the @collectLL slot, which contains this information.

mod <- mirt(Science, 1)
LL <- mod@collectLL
plot(1:length(LL), LL, type = 'b')
